title: Casual Lasagne
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried oregano, plus extra for sprinkling
method: In a large bowl, mix the minced beef, chopped tomatoes, passata, tomato purée, balsamic vinegar, carrots, garlic granules, onion granules, paprika and oregano together, breaking up the mince. Crush the beef stock cube in and season with salt and pepper.

Spoon one-third of the meat mixture into the slow-cooker pot, then cover with 2 lasagne sheets (break these up to fit). Spread over one-third of the cottage cheese to cover the lasagne sheets and one-third of the Cheddar. Repeat twice more so you have 3 layers. On the top layer, break up the mozzarella to cover and sprinkle over a little extra oregano.
Turn the slow-cooker to low, and cook for 4-5 hours.
If you want the cheese browned on top, pop the pot under a hot grill for a few minutes. Serve scattered with curly parsley.
notes: Stick to the low setting for this one — it doesn't work so well on high. Oven method: 170°C/150°C fan, Gas Mark 3, casserole with lid, 2 hours.
